intro: The same five roles re-reviewed the frozen d04 build independently: they confirmed 85 checks of the landed items as fixed, 35 as partly fixed and 2 as regressed, and reported 62 findings, 50 of them new in d04. The regression both the visual and adversarial reviewers measured was real: bringing an opened reading list into view put a row under the resting pointer, so a double click picked a reading. It is fixed (a press at the same point right after a panel scroll is ignored) and a check now proves the same double click writes a reading on frozen d04 and nothing on the tree. 48 of the 62 findings are fixed in the working tree after d04; the table lists every one with its status.
